notes: The supplied existential there is is placed on the substantival article's own unit: the Greek clause is verbless with no predicate, so rule 56 leaves the subject to carry it, and rule 96 allows an article that itself realizes a pronoun to carry a copula predicated of it. The unit's note records the competing placement on the participle.
τῆς ἀνομίας leaves the article unrepresented under rule 23 and keeps of with the noun under rule 21's determinerless clause.
ἐκ μέσου gives out of to the preposition and the supplied determiner to the anarthrous nominal under rule 51's anarthrous clause.
